title: Finite Tor dimension over an inverse-image structure sheaf
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes and let $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Say that $E$ has finite Tor dimension as an object of $D(f^{-1}\mathcal O_S)$ if, after restriction of scalars along $f^{-1}\mathcal O_S\to\mathcal O_X$, it has Tor amplitude in some finite interval: there are integers $a\le b$ such that $H^i(E\otimes^L_{f^{-1}\mathcal O_S}\mathcal F)=0$ for every $f^{-1}\mathcal O_S$-module $\mathcal F$ and every $i\notin[a,b]$.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.27.1 (Tag 08EV), hypothesis (3), using Definition 20.48.1 (Tag 08CG)
